concepts.def: Total external area of an object
Space taken up by an object
Surface area ÷ volume — falls as size rises
Tiny air sac in the lung for gas exchange

walkthroughs.body_html:
A 1 cm cube has SA 6 cm² and V 1 cm³ — ratio 6:1.

A 2 cm cube has SA 24, V 8 — ratio 3:1. Big things have lower SA:V and need transport systems.

Alveoli are millions of tiny sacs — huge surface area.

Walls are one cell thick. Each is surrounded by capillaries. Result: rapid O₂ in, CO₂ out by diffusion.

Arteries: thick muscular walls, high pressure. Veins: thin walls, valves, low pressure.

Capillaries: one cell thick — site of exchange with tissues.
